name: Surveillance top diseases

cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial {nct_id: 'NCT00000102'})<-[:REFERENCED_IN]-(a:Article) RETURN a.pmid, a.title LIMIT 10

cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {gene_name: 'BRCA1'})<-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]-(d:Drug) WITH g, count(d) AS drugs MATCH (p:Protein {gene_name: 'BRCA1'})-[:HAS_GO_TERM]->(go:GOTerm) RETURN g.gene_name, drugs, count(go) AS go_terms

name: E. coli proteins

cypher: MATCH (c:Country) WHERE c.income_level = 'Low income' WITH c LIMIT 10 MATCH (c)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND s.year = 2022 RETURN c.name, s.value ORDER BY s.value LIMIT 10

cypher: MATCH (a:Article {pmid: '30571862'})<-[:CITES]-(c:Article)-[:CITES]->(b:Article) WHERE a <> b RETURN b.pmid, count(c) AS co_citations ORDER BY co_citations DESC LIMIT 10

cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au1:Author {name: 'Smith J'}) WITH a LIMIT 50 MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au2:Author) WHERE au2.name <> 'Smith J' RETURN au2.name, count(a) AS collaborations ORDER BY collaborations DESC LIMIT 10

name: Drug interaction network size
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) WITH d, count(se) AS ses RETURN avg(ses) AS avg_side_effects_per_drug

cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WITH d, count(g) AS genes RETURN avg(genes) AS avg_genes_per_drug

cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WITH g.gene_name AS gn, d MATCH (p:Protein {gene_name: gn}) WHERE p.name CONTAINS 'kinase' RETURN d.name, gn, p.name LIMIT 10

name: Lyase proteins count
